notes.title: Performance increases
notes.content:
Changed how internal resolution scaling works.
Changed the default resolution. May change it again in the future if required for certain users.
Changed some settings which will have less demands by the system for running the game, which should make it easier for the engine to run it with the changes they did to it.

notes.title: FPS improvements
notes.content:
Spaced some stuff more out
changed the FPS minimum to run
Demo will be updated later.

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements
notes.content:
Made the minimum FPS higher.
 Removed the main FPS cap for higher end devices. Should allow for higher end devices to have better FPS.
 Fixed some bugs with the camera.

notes.title: Small changes
notes.content:
Made it where zooming in and out does more at a time
 Made it where using WASD goes slightly faster while holding.

notes.title: Optimizations and FPS improvements
notes.content:
Some players were having worse/unstable FPS at times, this was due to many things trying to access important arrays in memory at the same time. This has mostly been improved.

Changed backend to make sure AIs don't do actions too much at the same time to eat away at the engine's memory limit.
 Changed how the stock market runs in the backend so it is more memory optimized.
 General improvements to how nation data is showcased along with other stuff. for memory optimizations.
Auto save happens every 180 seconds instead of 60.

Players shouldn't see any bumps in performance outside the first 2 seconds of loading into the game
